mechanism: Voriconazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, which can increase vitamin D metabolism and alter its bioavailability, while vitamin D may affect voriconazole levels through CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor vitamin D levels and bone health status during concurrent use; adjust vitamin D supplementation if necessary based on serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D concentrations.
